title: Addressing Transitional Aged Youth Homelessness / Evidence-Driven Strategies / Outreach / Milestones and Timeline Implementation
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Administrative Office, with the support of the Bureau of Homelessness Oversight at the Los Angeles Housing Department, report to Council within 90 days on a strategy to urgently address Transitional Aged Youth homelessness, using evidence-driven strategies. Development of this strategy should include: • Consultation with TAY providers operating in the City, including but not limited to: The Village Family Services, Aviva Family Services, Safe Place for Youth, Hollywood Homeless Youth Partnership, My Friend’s Place, etc. to inform the City’s strategy; 1 Research, Education, and Advocacy Co-Lab for Youth Stability and Thriving (REALYST). (2018). Homeless youth risk and resilience survey. 2 Hunter, Sarah B., Joan S. Tucker, Jason M. Ward, and Rick Garvey, Understanding the Needs of Transition Age Youth Navigating the Foster Care and Housing Systems in Los Angeles County. Santa Monica, CA: RAND Corporation, 2024. https://www.rand.org/pubs/research_reports/RRA3310-1. html. Outreach to and engagement with philanthropic organizations, including LA4LA, to partner on this effort; Identified funding, including but not limited to HHAP TAY set-aside, including a plan to ensure the City is meeting its expenditure deadlines under HHAP awards; Immediate usage of HHAP TAY set-aside dollars for purposes aligning with this strategy; Collaborate with the regional housing authorities to maximize the use of federally funded vouchers, such as the Foster Youth to Independence vouchers to permanently house TAY living within the City; Transition/exit planning for TAY potentially displaced by the next federal Department of Housing and Urban Development’s Continuum of Care funding round, as over 800 TAY households are currently housed using federal CoC dollars; and Proposed project milestones and timeline for strategy implementation. PRESENTED BY: Ww/Ceune- NITHYA RAMAN Council member, 4th District KATY YAROSLAVSKY Councilmember, 5th District / BOB BEOMENFIED— Councilmember, 3rd District SECONDED BY: AUG 1 9 2026 ORIGINAL
